issue.title: Documentation for `ExactSizeIterator` does not make clear that `len()` should change with iteration

issue.body:
Reading between the lines on [`ExactSizeIterator`](https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/std/iter/trait.ExactSizeIterator.html#) (and investigating other implementations), it appears that the value of the returned `len()` should change as iteration occurs.

This is very subtle, and was missed by our entire team, see https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/issues/5149.

This information should be discussed prominently in the docs.

# Objective

Fix #5149

## Solution

Instead of returning the **total count** of elements in the `QueryIter` in
`size_hint`, we return the **count of remaining elements**. This
Fixes #5149 even when #5148 gets merged.

- https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/issues/5149
- https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/pull/5148

- Fix partially consumed `QueryIter` and `QueryCombinationIter` having invalid `size_hint`

issue.body:
## Bevy version

cd4c684ad5563c99b01e4ee6eea7c9b560c5dd5a

## What you did

I read the documentation of [ExactSizeIterator](https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/iter/trait.ExactSizeIterator.html), and notice that this requirement isn't true:
```
When implementing an ExactSizeIterator, you must also implement Iterator.
When doing so, the implementation of Iterator::size_hint must return the exact size of the iterator.
```
In the [standard implementation](https://doc.rust-lang.org/src/core/iter/traits/exact_size.rs.html#96-104) this is checked with an assertion.

Instead of providing an exact size_hint, Bevy [overrides](https://github.com/bevyengine/bevy/blob/main/crates/bevy_ecs/src/query/iter.rs#L119-L125) that function, which removes the need for that invariant to be true.

While it isn't a problem here, it would still be nice if QueryIter would provide an exact size_hint if it can.
